_what: THE ROUTING TABLE. Every gate in this repo can say a check FAILED. Not one of them could say WHO FIXES IT. This file closes that gap: check name -> the seat that owns it, the concrete fix, and which gate re-runs to prove the fix worked.
_why: Gavril's doctrine, stated 2026-08-06: 'if one fails it redirects to respect parts or seats or agent to refix it again and again until it passes'. Before this file that routing was a person reading output and deciding by hand, which meant it died with every chat. The repo is the memory; the routing has to live in the repo.
_rule: KEYS MUST MATCH THE GATE'S EMITTED STRING BYTE FOR BYTE. They were extracted from the source on 2026-08-06, not typed from memory. tools/mastermind_loop.py --audit re-extracts them and fails loudly on any drift. A routing table that silently misses is worse than none, because it reports 'no owner' for a check that has one.
_readers: MASTERMIND.md             — renders it; the doc holds no second copy

MASTERMIND.owns: the plan, and the final verdict on the cut. First planner, last judge.

STRATEGIST.owns: title decode, pillar choice, audience, the claim

SCRIPTWRITER.owns: beat spine, twist, CTA, card copy

DIRECTOR.owns: shot list, coverage, what happens in each shot

PERFORMANCE.owns: what the human does on screen

EMOTION.owns: the felt arc, why a viewer stays

FOLEY.owns: diegetic sound, what each shot sounds like

SOUND_ENGINEER.owns: bed, mix, loudness, ducking, transient design

EDITOR.owns: cut points, rhythm, repetition, captions on the timeline

TECHNOLOGIST.owns: plates, generation params, cost, tooling, file hygiene

J0.owns: THE HOOK. Solo veto. Nothing ships past a dead first 2 seconds.

PANEL.owns: J1-J6 reception: is it worth watching at all

OPERATOR.owns: Gavril. Naming, filesystem, spending, and every judgement Claude may not make.

_decidable_at.plan: free. Fix in plans/<name>.py and re-run planqc. ALWAYS prefer this.
_decidable_at.clip: costs 22.5cr to regenerate. Fix the PROMPT in the plan, then regenerate that one clip.
_decidable_at.cut: free to rebuild. Fix the plan or the engine input, then re-run build + verify.
_decidable_at.eye: Claude may not decide this. Present evidence, Gavril rules.

1 duration.fix: timeline() disagrees with TARGET_S. One of them is wrong — usually BEATS was copied from a plan at a different BPM.

2 pillar band.fix: Shot count or shot lengths are off this pillar's measured band. Change BEATS or the shot list, never the profile.

2b shot extremes.fix: One shot dominates the runtime. Split it or shorten it.

3 coverage.fix: Too few distinct sources for the cut rate. Add a source or cut fewer times.

4 source balance.fix: One clip is carrying too many shots, or a paid source is never used.

5 adjacency.fix: Two neighbouring shots come from one clip. Reorder, or take one from another source.

6 crop cap.fix: A punch-in exceeds MAX_CROP. 1.9x measured an 82% loss of sharpness. Lower the crop, do not raise the cap.

7 crop distribution.fix: Crops cluster, or shot 0 opens cropped, or a hold is cropped. Redistribute.

8 repeat framing.fix: The same (source, crop) appears twice — the same picture twice. Change one, or declare it in CALLBACKS if it is a deliberate rhyme.

9 hook is an EVENT.fix: Shot 0 must be an EVENT act and be over inside 2.00s. A tour is not a hook. J0 has solo veto.

10 hold placement.fix: A hold sits on a shot with nothing to hold on. Move it to a PAYOFF, HUMAN or EVENT.

11 blends.fix: Blend count, width or kind is outside the profile. BLEND_KIND 'dip' fades through black and auto-fails.

12 caption zone.fix: A card sits in the centre band, overruns the shot count, or exceeds the pillar's word limit.

12b card style.fix: CARD_STYLE=narrative raises the word limit. Confirm that is intended for this pillar.

13 reference plates.fix: A plate is not 4k, a cited plate does not exist, or a human source does not carry the identity reference. A text-only prompt for a named subject returns a stranger.

14 prompt quality.fix: Every prompt needs the realism clause, a negative block, and a reference-image citation.

15 quality defaults.fix: MODE must be std, never fast chosen silently to save money. AI label is a human step at upload, never burned in.

16 shot mix.fix: Act distribution is far off the pillar's mix. Warn only — deliberate deviation is allowed if stated.

17 cost.fix: Total exceeds the MEASURED balance. Measure the balance, never estimate — a past estimate was off by 352cr.

18 content.fix: CONTENT needs claim, verification source, twist and why_stop. A build with no claim has nothing to be right about.

19 sound design.fix: FOLEY/SOUND missing or incomplete. Clip audio is generated and PAID FOR; the plan must decide how it is used before spend.

20 transitions.fix: A blend touches an EVENT shot. A state change dissolved is a state change nobody saw.

21 source capacity.fix: A source is asked for more seconds than the clip has. Split the source or shorten its shots.

22 premortem.fix: Need >=3 (risk, mitigation) pairs predicting THIS build's mistakes, read from the ledger.

22b premortem cites.fix: No premortem entry cites an L<n> lesson. A premortem must READ the ledger, not free-associate.

23 lessons ack.fix: LESSONS_ACK must equal the ledger's CURRENT count for this pillar topic and for general craft. Under-count = stale; over-count = invented.

23b neighbouring genres.fix: Informational: other pillars' lesson counts, often the closest prior art. Read them before planning a new pillar — filing every lesson under car_cinematic made every later pillar start blind.

24 linkage.fix: Every boundary needs a declared connection intent.

24b linkage measured.fix: Measured brightness discontinuity at a boundary, from the ingest manifest.

25 field sanity.fix: A DELOGO rect, SFX_OVERLAY window, FOLEY key or card character is out of bounds. These reach the engine as literals.

26 style declared.fix: This pillar has no style block, so it would silently inherit the car-night defaults. Declare the pillar in PILLAR-PROFILES.json.

26b style provisional.fix: The band is a structural CHOICE, not a measurement. Re-derive from real clips at first ingest and only then mark it MEASURED.

26c editor exists?.fix: cut_spine=sentence — the speech-led editor is not built. Do not plan a long-form cut against it yet.

27 identity coverage.fix: Too many human sources opted out of the face read. Identity may be waived per shot with a reason, never entirely.

28 framing diversity.fix: Two sources share a plate and declare the same framing. A plate anchors PLACE and, unqualified, FRAMING too — measured on KK v1 as 5 shots of one image.

29 linkage carry.fix: A linkage token does not appear in the writing of BOTH shots it joins. The plan contradicts itself in prose.

29b prose linkages.fix: Some boundaries are prose, not typed (kind, token, why). Type them so they can be checked.

30 time monotonic.fix: The clock runs backwards or jumps. KK v15 ran golden->night->daylight->morning under a '6PM' card.

31 consequence spine.fix: Too few CONSEQUENCE boundaries. Resemblance is continuity; only consequence makes a story. Non-blocking by design.

readable.fix: File is corrupt or truncated. Re-download before assuming the generation failed.

0 role resolved.fix: Filename did not match a source key, so the EVENT, foley and face gates DID NOT RUN. Rename to <project>_<KEY>_*.mp4 or pass --key, then re-gate.

specs.fix: Wrong resolution or duration. Check the generation parameters before regenerating.

no-settle open.fix: Static head. Warn only — the engine centres on the action peak, so the head is the wrong measurement.

delivered window.fix: The window that will actually PLAY is below this pillar's motion floor. Regenerate with explicit camera movement in the prompt.

alive after 2s.fix: Dead air past 2s. Warn only if the plan never cuts past it.

brightness.fix: Outside this pillar's brightness band. If the band is PROVISIONAL, check the band before rejecting a 22.5cr clip.

sharpness.fix: Soft clip. Regenerate; the edit cannot add sharpness.

EVENT window (delivered).fix: The event is weak in the window that plays. PROVISIONAL and non-blocking — the floor's provenance is unverified (approvals.json UNV-1). Do not tighten it; re-derive or ask.

EVENT is the loudest thing.fix: The event does not dominate its own clip. It exists but does not read.

foley source audible.fix: A shot mixed foreground has no usable audio. The paid diegetic layer would ship silent.

on-subject text -> EYE.fix: Read the text-zoom PNG. Models write gibberish on every legible surface — an invented 'SR' badge shipped through 8 builds. Reject (22.5cr) or plan a DELOGO patch (free).

face READS (delivered window).fix: Presence is not the standard, legibility is. Claude may present matched-scale crops; the identity verdict is Gavril's, always.

0 freshness.fix: The output is older than an input. REBUILD. Every number below it is measuring the wrong file — nothing else runs until this passes.

1 qc.py profile.fix: The cut is off the pillar profile. Change the plan's shot lengths, not the profile.

2 cut-to-music.fix: Cuts are not landing on the bed's grid. Check BED_OFFSET phase fitting, and that BPM matches the bed.

3 sfx audible.fix: Transient does not lift at the cut. Over a dense bed no mix gain can score +2 — check which regime applies before chasing gain.

4 repetition.fix: Adjacent shots barely change the image. Change the source or the framing in the plan.

5 exposure match.fix: Big luma swing at a cut. DO NOT close this by relighting — v14 bought a smooth number by moving an approved shot +72 luma. See check 15.

6 caption zone.fix: A card is in the centre band where the subject lives.

7 action peaks.fix: Shots with no action peak. With exclusive window allocation a source with 3 shots and 2 peaks is scarcity, not a broken pick — but the HOOK must always have one.

8 audio.fix: LUFS, true peak or silence ratio outside band. True peak exists only in the delivered encode.

9 true black frames.fix: A truly black frame is in the cut. Check blend kind — 'dip' fades through black.

10 far repeats.fix: Two NON-ADJACENT shots share footage. Gavril found the payoff replaying the tease's exact frames by eye.

11 transitions.fix: A blend lands off the beat grid, or smears the frame.

12 storyboard tally.fix: The built cut disagrees with the plan: shot count, overlapping windows, or an unused paid source.

13 composition dupes.fix: Two shots share a composition, deliberately blind to colour. Threshold 0.93 is fitted to THREE eyeballed samples — widen the sample before trusting it further.

14 place variety.fix: Too many shots in the same visual place. Framing variety is not place variety — optimising framing moved dupes 3->0 while place repeats held at 7.

15 relight audit.fix: The edit relit a shot past its declared luma budget. NON-BLOCKING BY INSTRUCTION: 'dont lock it i want you to learn from it'. A number that blocks gets obeyed and stops being thought about.

LRA.fix: Loudness range too flat — the whole file sits at one level. Integrated LUFS and true peak can both be perfect while LRA is 1.0. Threshold 4.0 is a declared CHOICE, not a measurement.

repeat pairs.fix: Non-adjacent shot pairs over the correlation threshold. 0.90 is a declared CHOICE.

event curve.fix: The biggest visual event is outside the first 3 seconds. Open on an EVENT, not a tour.

1.fix: A pipeline file reads a plan key with a SILENT DEFAULT the plan does not define. Add the key or the build is quietly wrong.

2.fix: A plan declares a name no pipeline file reads. Either label it a note IN THE FILE, or it is a claimed capability.

3.fix: Undefined name — NameError when that line runs, usually swallowed by a bare except.

4.fix: Shared pipeline code hardcodes one project's name, so it silently does nothing for every other project.

_not_routed._what: Failures no table can own, recorded so their absence is deliberate rather than forgotten.
_not_routed.identity: Is it HIM? The verdict FLIPPED between crop scales on KK — 'not him' at thumbnail, 'plausibly him' at matched size, same frames, same session. Claude presents evidence at matched scale. Gavril rules. Always.
_not_routed.is it good: No gate in this repo measures whether anything HAPPENS. 13 gates measure conformance to a profile built from 23 scraped strangers. That is the standing gap and routing cannot close it.
_not_routed.does it perform: Zero posts, ever. Until one real 24-hour curve exists, every retention target is a hypothesis and no seat can be held accountable for it.
